## [1.2.1](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1) (2026-11-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* remove ads and ad-related traffic ([#10](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/issues/10)) ([ef31c59](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/commit/ef31c5977a8483b812283df94d41403de1a29312)), closes [#11](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/issues/11)

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics and automatic page tracking, and stops the app's analytics, log-upload and attribution subsystems from starting.

options.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics.
Removes the analytics, log-upload, API event, page tracking and AppsFlyer attribution startup pipelines so they never start.

patches.name: Hide AI assistant
patches.description: Hides the "Hey Tuya" AI assistant added in app 7.0 (the AI bar on the home and smart tabs, the device-panel floating ball, the launcher shortcut and the other entry points). This is a runtime toggle: it can be turned on and off in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen (long-press the settings button in the profile tab, or the Settings screen toolbar). Hidden by default.

patches.name: Hide Smart App tab
patches.description: Hides the "Smart App" tab (AI app builder) at the top of the smart tab. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Disables in-app ads (including the AdMob native ad on the home screen), promotional banners, ad push, and ad-related attribution. Stops the corresponding advertising subsystems and removes Home/Profile ad entries.

options.description: Removes the ad, ad-push and attribution startup pipelines so they never start.
Removes the marketing, PID banner and shopping mall cards from Home and the advertising, welfare banner and mall rows from Profile.
Also unregisters the ad, marketing booth, ad push and AppsFlyer services. A screen that still looks one of them up may crash, so this is off by default.

patches.name: Hide home recommendations
patches.description: Hides the "おすすめ" (Recommended) cards on the home screen. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.

patches.name: Hide scene recommendations
patches.description: Hides the recommended scenes ("お勧め") shown under the automation and tap-to-run lists of the smart tab. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.

patches.name: SmartLife Patches settings
patches.description: Adds two ways to open the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen: long-press the settings button at the top of the profile tab, or long-press the toolbar of the app's Settings screen.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Keeps the original APK signature visible to the app after re-signing, so the app's integrity self-check passes instead of showing "integrity check failed" and quitting, and so email/phone + password login keeps working. Enabled by default because the app does not start without it.

release_notes:
## [1.2.1](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1) (2026-11-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* remove ads and ad-related traffic ([#10](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/issues/10)) ([ef31c59](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/commit/ef31c5977a8483b812283df94d41403de1a29312)), closes [#11](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/issues/11)


### 📝 Details

**Hide ads**
* Hide the AdMob native ad (with the "i" badge and an install button) shown above Favorites on the home screen. It does not read the app's ad flags and is not listed in the home layout config, so earlier versions of this patch could not remove it.
* Stop AdMob ad slots on the home and profile screens.
* Stop the AdMob startup and login subsystems added in SmartLife 7.12.6.
* Remove the marketing card, PID banner and shopping mall from Home, and the advertising, welfare banner and mall rows from Profile.
* Also stop the AppsFlyer attribution pipeline.
* New options: `Stop ad subsystems`, `Remove Home/Profile ad entries`, and `Remove ad services (experimental)` (off by default). The experimental option now matches the service names the app actually uses.

**Disable telemetry**
* Stop the analytics, log-upload, API event, page-tracking, notification-permission stats and AppsFlyer attribution subsystems from starting.
* New option: `Stop tracking subsystems`.

**General**
* App config files are now edited structurally instead of by text replacement. A config file that is missing or cannot be read is skipped with a warning instead of failing the whole patch.

Patches apply to SmartLife 7.12.0 and 7.12.6.
